Initial release of work-productivity-agent-browser-workflow-helper.

- Supports users needing practical help with Agent Browser-style workflows (bug fixes, reliability, safety, or skill adaptations).
- Follows a structured workflow to clarify requirements, plan, and deliver actionable outputs like checklists, code, or workflows.
- Outputs are optimized for local hardware (scripts, templates, CPU/model-friendly).
- Provides clear validation steps, usage notes, and highlights remaining risks or follow-up work.
- Triggers on keywords related to work productivity, browser automation, and workflow optimization.
